name: Ahwaz

queries.query: اهواز نقشه کاداستر املاک GIS شهرداری اهواز سامانه ثبت اسناد نقشه قطعات
queries.scope: Find a first-party Ahwaz municipal or provincial parcel registry/map service.
queries.result: Search results did not surface a first-party Ahwaz parcel-cadastre service. A third-party directory references gis.ahvaz.ir as an Ahvaz map portal, and a third-party app listing describes the municipal “Ahvaz My” application as including a city map, but neither confirms parcel cadastral layers. A secondary description of the Khuzestan provincial registry office concerns registration operations rather than a public map.
queries.executionMethod: Persian web search and read-only direct request to the cited GIS hostname.

queries.scope: Check English-language primary evidence for local parcel registry and vector access.
queries.result: No first-party city or provincial parcel viewer/vector source was located. National Iranian land-cadastre references alone were not counted as evidence of a local public parcel registry. The municipal GIS hostname reset the direct connection; this does not establish provider unavailability.
